html:
The Chontal of Oaxaca, who call themselves Slijuala Xanuc, are an Indigenous people of the southern Sierra Madre and the Pacific coast of Oaxaca, Mexico, west of the Isthmus of Tehuantepec. "Chontal" is a Nahuatl word for "foreigner", given to several unrelated peoples.

Their Tequistlatecan languages, one of the highlands and one of the coast, form a small family of their own. In the late 1400s they fought the Zapotecs, who were pushing into the Tehuantepec region, and held on to much of their rugged country. Other neighbours were the Mixe and the Huave. After the Spanish conquest they came under New Spain. Their languages are now spoken by only a few thousand people, most of them older.
